items.title: James "Sugarboy" Crawford Interview, 1975-04-29
items.q: I don't see, uh, how Jimmy Clanton got hung up with him in the first place.

ctx.x: He tried to pull every kind of trick in a book just to make a doll on him.
I know you messed up Uriah Smith. I guess he would've, uh, probably, probably did a good job of messing around. And I don't see, uh, how Jimmy Clanton got hung up with him in the first place.
Well, Clanton had, uh, Clanton was like cute. I mean, like, a lot. He was only like 19 when he started.
